mode.title: Mode
mode.description: search = full-text search of stories/comments; thread = a whole discussion flattened; users = user profiles; monthlyThreads = posts from the monthly Who is hiring / Who wants to be hired / Freelancer threads.

queries.title: Search queries (mode: search)
queries.description: Keywords. Leave empty to list everything of the chosen type in the date range.

sortByDate.title: Sort by date (mode: search)
sortByDate.description: Newest first instead of by relevance.

minPoints.title: Minimum points (mode: search)
minPoints.description: Only items with at least this many points.

items.title: Items (mode: thread)
items.description: HN item URLs or IDs, e.g. https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=8863.

threadKind.title: Monthly thread (mode: monthlyThreads)
threadKind.description: hiring = Who is hiring?; wanted = Who wants to be hired?; freelance = Freelancer? Seeking freelancer?

monthsBack.title: Months (mode: monthlyThreads)
monthsBack.description: How many of the latest monthly threads to read.

keywordFilter.title: Keyword filter (mode: monthlyThreads)
keywordFilter.description: Keep only posts mentioning any of these words, e.g. python, remote, visa.

maxItemsPerQuery.title: Max items per query / thread
maxItemsPerQuery.description: Upper bound on rows per query, thread or monthly thread. Search returns at most 1000 hits per query (Algolia limit).
